# Installing/Configuring Visual Studio Code

It is **strongly** encouraged to only follow instructions found at [https://code.visualstudio.com](https://code.visualstudio.com). These are the official instructions and will be updated accordingly.

## Installing Visual Studio Code

To download and install Visual Studio Code follow the instructions for your OS found at [https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/setup/setup-overview](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/setup/setup-overview).

* [macOS](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/setup/mac)
* [Windows](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/setup/windows)
* [Linux](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/setup/linux)

## Configuring Visual Studio Code for Go

To configure Visual Studio Code for Go development follow the instructions on how to install the Go extension found at [https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/languages/go](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/languages/go).

Before the extension can be used you must first install the Go tools needed for the extension. To do this, open the Command Palette, `View > Command Palette`, then find and run the `Go: Install/Update Tools` command. Once the tools are installed Visual Studio Code will be ready to develop Go in.

At various points throughout this course we will revisit the topic of configuring Visual Studio Code further as needed.

> Extension Documentation: [https://github.com/golang/vscode-go/blob/master/docs/features.md](https://github.com/golang/vscode-go/blob/master/docs/features.md)
